flavor.phonemic_palette: Fused Norse-Nahuatl: stops p t k, the dentals th/tl, affricates tz/ts, x (sh), hu/w, ku, glottal stop; nominative -r and absolutive -tl collide into fused endings -atl/-tr/-r; root-initial stress with Nahuatl penults.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Norse + Aztec per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Norse + Aztec register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'huitzilan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Huitzilan — xenophobic clan confederation of the jungle; strength, glory.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Huitzilan (Norse + Aztec) are a expansionist clan confederation people seeded in jungle, mountains, glacial mountains. They prize strength, glory, wealth, lean toward the military sphere, and field berserkers, heavy_infantry, marines. Outsiders are met as xenophobic; their patrons touch war, death, plunder.
